notes.title: Happy Island Fantasy - Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Adventurers,

We’re excited to share that Happy Island Fantasy is now officially available on Steam!  

Dive into a captivating island world crafted for mature audiences, where you can immerse yourself in a unique and intimate adventure. We invite you to experience this sensual journey and explore all that the island has to offer. 

Thank you for your support throughout our development process. Your encouragement has brought Happy Island Fantasy to life. 

Start your adventure today on Steam and share your thoughts with us on our Community Hub or social media. We can’t wait to hear about your experience! 

Enjoy your fantasy escape
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668560/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the latest update for our game, bringing enhanced visuals and smoother gameplay! Here’s what’s new:

1. Added 2K and 4K Resolution Options: Enjoy stunning HD visuals with newly supported 2K and 4K resolutions for a sharper, more immersive experience.
2. Optimized In-Game Scenes: Select environments have been redrawn with improved detail and precision, elevating the overall aesthetic.
3. Enhanced Animation Scenes: Certain animations have been refined for greater smoothness and sophistication, making every moment more captivating.

Thank you for your continued support! Dive in and experience the upgraded visuals today!

notes.title: Join Us at Steam Next Fest – Try Our New Game!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Community
  We’re thrilled to announce that our brand-new game, \[Happy Island Fantasy]is participating in Steam Next Fest, starting today! This is your chance to dive into our latest creation, explore its world, and share your thoughts with us. 
  As valued players, your feedback has always shaped our work, and we’d love for you to experience \[Happy Island Fantasy] during this exciting event. Head over to Steam, download the demo, and let us know your suggestions to help make it even better! 
  Visit the \[Happy Island Fantasy] Steam page here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668560/Happy_Island_Fantasy/"][/dynamiclink]  We’ll also continue to update and maintain \[WorkPlace Fantasy] and as always, feel free to reach out to our official customer support with any questions or issues. 
  Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 
                                                                                                                            Best[/p]

notes.title: Game Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear Players,
    We’re thrilled to share the latest update for our game, designed to enhance your gameplay and address community feedback. Below are the key changes:

Special Update
    We deeply apologize for the English content errors caused by staff mistake. We’ve extensively revised all English text to correct these issues. Our team is dedicated to ongoing corrections, adjustments, and optimizations to ensure the best possible experience. We regret any inconvenience this may have caused our players.

Update Details
1.Adjusted Task Difficulty and Added Hints: We’ve balanced task difficulty and introduced in-game hints to improve flow and optimize the gaming experience.
2.Bug Fixes: Fixed known bugs and refined error messages for a more stable and seamless experience.
3.Sound Effect Optimization: Upgraded select sound effects to create a more immersive audio environment.

 If you have any issues or feedback, please reach out to our official customer support team. Thank you for your unwavering support and understanding.
Best regards,
The Development Team

notes.title: DLC Release Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you all players for your support and waiting, New DLC "Shopping Street Story" is coming!
The results of the characters voted for by players in March are finally out. Based on players' preferences, we have officially launched a new story-based commercial street with "Jasmine" as the main storyline, and "Rose" and "Aichan" as branch stories. How will their story unfold? Is this what you expected? We look forward to every player's ideas, please contact us!
Official Discord:  https://discord.gg/fcCRZ4JfdY

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606670/

notes.title: Announcement of Voting Activity& Version Preview
notes.content:
The voting event has now concluded! Thank you to all players for your enthusiastic participation and support. We received nearly 10,000 votes and additional suggestions, with Jasmine ultimately claiming first place with overwhelming popularity, followed by Aichan in second place and Rose in third. Moving forward, we will prioritize development based on the story of our popularity champion, Jasmine, and aim to release the new version in April 2025.  

Once again, we sincerely appreciate every player's support, understanding, and active engagement. Your contributions have provided invaluable guidance, and we will continue striving to create exceptional content worthy of your trust. Thank you for being part of this journey! notes.title: Q1 2024 Update Preview
notes.content:
1-Thank you to all players for their support and encouragement of our game. We will continue to optimize the CG animation in the game, redraw and modify images that are not refined enough, and update them irregularly every week.
2-We are currently creating two new protagonist story flow DLCs, and in order to ensure the quality and richness of the content, we are expected to meet with everyone in mid April.
3-We are also working on the ending of the game to ensure that the entire story has a beginning and an end. The exact release time is yet to be determined.
4-In the near future, we will still listen to player feedback and try to fix any negative experiences in the game.
5-Thank you again for your support. Although our team size is limited and content updates may be relatively slow, we will still maintain our best spirit and continue to bring high-quality content to players.
6-We will update and add languages such as Korean, Thai, French, Portuguese, and Russian in the near future; For the convenience of players from various language regions to play; Due to the limited financial resources of the studio, Google Translate is used for translation. Therefore, it is recommended to use the existing four languages. We hope everyone can understand and support this.
